label: The page rule is seven statements across three files, so a one-file fix leaves six live statements of a rule the vendor API forbids.
Gate replacement: the target becomes a named plan, file and section created if absent, with no existing content cleared.
Write-bullet replacement: write into a named section and extend it only by adding nodes this write creates.
Rollback replacement: delete the section this write created, or the ids it recorded, after reading the target and stopping on foreign content.
Uncertain-call rule: a failed call is not a no-op, so read the board before any retry.
fileKey reuse: pass the existing board key when revising and remove the previous diagram section before its replacement.
Containment: one diagram per section named for the diagram, with one legend section when colour carries meaning.
The kernel can carry the same rule in one sentence: write one diagram per call into a named section created if absent, never clearing content.
The mirror's Section 5 needs the same three replacements, since it deliberately drops the fj route but copies the page rule.
